info.title: 3Common API
info.description: Public REST API for the 3Common event management platform.

get.description:
Lists the workspace's emails, optionally filtered by view (draft / past).
Paginated; returns recipient-stripped summaries so list payloads stay small.
Sorted by updatedAt descending.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Filter by view; omit to include drafts + sent + scheduled.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
JSON-encoded FilterGroup[] for custom filtering. Conditions referencing
fields outside the persisted email schema are ignored. ANDed with the 'view'
filter when both are supplied.

parameters.name: sortField
parameters.description: Field to sort results by. Omit for default (updatedAt descending).

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc when sortField is provided.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive subject substring to search for.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of fields to return. Omit for all fields. Valid fields:
id, hostId, subject, sent, date_sent, reply_to_email, automatic, display_name, page_id, data_version, sync_event_recipients, attachments, sparkpost_metrics, activity_synced_at, createdAt, updatedAt, recipient_count

hasMore.description: If true, there are more pages of results available.

hostId.description: ID of the host workspace that owns this email.

sent.description: False for drafts; true once sent or scheduled.

date_sent.description: When the email was sent or is scheduled to send, as an ISO string. Undefined for drafts.

reply_to_email.description: Reply-to address. Falls back to a system address when unset.

automatic.description: Whether this email was generated by the automatic event-broadcast flow.

display_name.description: Sender label shown on the "From" line.

page_id.description: ID of the Page this email renders.

data_version.description: Which content format this email uses. Assume `content_blocks` (0) when absent.

sync_event_recipients.description: If true, scheduled sends re-sync recipients from the linked events at send time.

attachments.description: File attachments included with the email.

name.description: The original filename of the attachment.

sparkpost_metrics.description: Delivery metrics and referral revenue for a sent email.

count_delivered.description: Messages delivered to a recipient inbox (no bounce).

count_opens.description: Unique opens, counted by distinct recipient.

count_clicks.description: Unique clicks, counted by distinct recipient.

revenue_generated.description: Revenue attributed via referral tracking, minor units (cents)

fetched_at.description: Epoch ms when these metrics were last fetched from Sparkpost

activity_synced_at.description: Epoch ms when the activity feed was last synced from Sparkpost + orders.

recipient_count.description: Number of recipients for this email.

patch.description:
Updates an email's fields. Only provided fields change. The content field
accepted depends on the email's format: an email that renders a Page accepts
`page_id`; an email that renders embedded structured content accepts
`viewport_data`. Emails in the content_blocks format cannot be edited
through this API. If recipient_emails is supplied, typo-domain addresses are
stripped.

Stable id like "layout:1". Unique within the page.

content.description:
HTML rendered by the email editor (TipTap-based). Allowed:

,

-

, /, /, , , ,
    /
      /
    1. , ,
      ,
      ,
      , //
      /, for emoji, youtube iframes (YouTube embed extension). Text alignment via inline style="text-align: left| center|right" on block elements. Disallowed: inline color/background-color/font-family/font-size (the editor has no UI for them — they get stripped on re-edit), custom CSS classes,

cardHeight.description: Minimum row height in pixels. Default 100.

id.description: Stable id like "layout:2". Unique within the page.

columns.description:
Tuple [leftHTML, rightHTML]. Same HTML rules as one-column.content
(see its description).

dividerPos.description: Column split as a fraction (0-1). 0.5 = equal halves.

cardHeight.description: Minimum row height in pixels. Default 100.

event.description: Omit only for placeholder blocks the user will fill in via the UI.

url.description:
Event detail page URL. Must follow the format
https://3common.com/event/{event_id} where {event_id} is the event
ref id (the same id stored on the email's event_refs array).
Never construct ad-hoc URLs — recipients expect canonical 3common.com
links so referral tracking and unsubscribe substitution work.

image.description:
Image URL displayed at the top of the event card. Pick from, in
order of preference:
1. The event's own image (from get_event / list_events on the
event referenced by this email's event_refs).
2. A URL the user explicitly supplied in this conversation.
3. A URL surfaced via the web_search / web_fetch tools when
web access is enabled — only when (1) and (2) are absent
AND the user asked for promotional imagery. Cite the source.
Omit when no suitable image exists; the card renders cleanly
without one. Never invent a URL — broken images degrade trust.

dates.description: All event dates as ISO-8601 strings. Past dates are filtered out at render time; the earliest future date is the headline.

offset.description: Minutes from UTC at the event time.

layouts.description: Vertical stack of layouts. Render order = array order.

viewport_data.description:
Structured site-builder content — the AI-editable representation of
the email body. Compose the email by emitting a viewport_data tree
(pages → layouts → HTML blocks); do NOT supply pre-rendered HTML via
'body'. The send flow renders viewport_data into HTML automatically.
Most emails are a single page with a sequence of one-column
layouts. Use two-column for side-by-side content, and event-block
when promoting a specific event (give it the event id's url, name,
and date — never embed event details in an HTML column).
Layout ids must be unique within the page; "page:1", "layout:1",
"layout:2", ... is the simplest scheme. Pick cardHeight=100 unless
the design calls for taller rows.
Event link URLs (whether on event-block.event.url or inside an HTML
<a href="..."> in a one-column / two-column 'content' / 'columns'
string) MUST use the canonical format:
https://3common.com/event/{event_id}
where {event_id} is the id from the email's event_refs array.
Don't invent ad-hoc URLs — recipients click these to land on the
real event page, and referral tracking + unsubscribe substitution
rely on the canonical host.
Do NOT include {{unsubscribeUrl}} or any other {{…}} substitution
placeholder anywhere in viewport_data. The api-server's email
template renders the unsubscribe footer itself; emitting it in the
body produces a duplicated, broken link.
Styling beyond what TipTap exposes (custom font colors, font
families, font sizes outside the h1-h6 progression, background
colors) is NOT supported — the editor has no UI for it and round-
trips will strip it. Use semantic tags (h1-h6 for size, strong/em
for emphasis) instead of inline style.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an email. No soft-delete; the row is removed.

post.description:
Sends an email through Sparkpost immediately. Stamps date_sent + sent=true
on the persisted document.
Seamless flow: call with just `id` once the draft has subject, recipients,
viewport_data, and reply_to_email set. The server pulls those fields from
the persisted doc and renders viewport_data to HTML server-side if no body
is already rendered. Only pass fields other than `id` when you explicitly
need to override the persisted values for this one send.

html.description:
Pre-rendered HTML body. Usually omitted, the server renders viewport_data
automatically if no body is persisted. Supply only when you need to override
the persisted body for this one send.

subject.description: Override the persisted subject for this send. Newlines are stripped server-side.

senderName.description: Override the persisted display_name on the From line.

recipients.description: Override the persisted recipient list. Typo-domain addresses are stripped server-side. For page-based emails this overrides the typed recipients and is still merged with the synced event/timeslot audience.

attachments.description: Override the persisted attachments. URLs are downloaded and base64-encoded before transmission to Sparkpost.

post.description:
Schedules an email for future delivery. Stamps sent=true,
date_sent=<sendAt>, and a server-rendered body on the email, then enqueues a
scheduled job to send the message at sendAt.
Preconditions checked before scheduling:
- Email exists and is owned by the caller's workspace
- sendAt is strictly in the future
- Email has a non-empty subject
- Email has at least one recipient
- Email has viewport_data to render to HTML (or a previously-rendered body)
For immediate transmission, use send_email instead.

sendAt.description:
ISO timestamp for delivery. Must be strictly in the future. The
email must already have a subject, at least one recipient, and
viewport_data (the send pipeline renders it to HTML automatically).

post.description:
Creates a draft copy of an existing email. The source's content and metadata
(attachments, sender info, recipients, event refs) are cloned server-side;
the caller names the source and any field-level overrides. An email that
renders a Page accepts a `page_id` override; an email that renders
embedded structured content accepts a `viewport_data` override. Emails in
the content_blocks format cannot be duplicated through this API. Note that
if `page_id` is omitted, a duplicate of the page is also created and used
for the new email, so editing the new email's page will not affect others.
Use this when the user asks to "duplicate", "clone", "copy", or "resend" an
existing email, including the "duplicate and send to a different address"
flow. After this tool returns, call send_email with the returned email's id
to dispatch immediately, or schedule_email for a future send.
The duplicate is always created as a draft: sent=false, no date_sent,
automatic=false. Override only the fields that should differ from the source
(most commonly recipient_emails); everything else falls back to the source.

subject.description: Subject on the copy. Defaults to the source subject.

recipient_emails.description:
Recipient list on the copy. Defaults to the source's recipients.
Typo-domain addresses are stripped server-side. Pass an explicit
list (e.g. just the one address being re-sent to) when the caller
asks to "duplicate and send to X".

reply_to_email.description: Reply-to email on the copy. Defaults to source.

display_name.description: From-line display name on the copy. Defaults to source.

attachments.description: Override attachments on the copy. Defaults to the source attachments.

name.description: The original filename of the attachment.

page_id.description:
Page ID for the copy. Valid only when the source already uses a page_id. By
default, a copy of the source email's page will be created, meaning the new
email will have a different page_id from the original.

viewport_data.description: Structured content for the copy. Valid only when the source renders embedded content; defaults to the source content.

this will not include event attendees until send time.

event_refs.description: IDs of events whose attendees will be added to the recipients at send time.

timeslot_refs.description:
IDs of multi-day event timeslots whose attendees will be added to the
recipients at send time.

segment_refs.description:
IDs of segments whose members will be added to the recipients at send
time, with each member's segment columns available as smart values
(mail merge). The composer currently imports a single segment.

date_sent.description: When the email was sent or is scheduled to send, as an ISO string. Undefined for drafts.

footer_image.description: URL of the image shown in the email footer.

reply_to_email.description: Reply-to address. Falls back to a system address when unset.

automatic.description: Whether this email was generated by the automatic event-broadcast flow.

display_name.description: Sender label shown on the "From" line.

content_blocks.description: Deprecated legacy content. New emails use page_id instead.

viewport_data.description: Deprecated embedded structured content. New emails use page_id instead.

page_id.description: ID of the Page this email renders.

data_version.description: Which content format this email uses. Assume `content_blocks` (0) when absent.

sync_event_recipients.description: If true, scheduled sends re-sync recipients from the linked events at send time.

attachments.description: File attachments included with the email.

name.description: The original filename of the attachment.

sparkpost_metrics.description: Delivery metrics and referral revenue for a sent email.

count_delivered.description: Messages delivered to a recipient inbox (no bounce).

count_opens.description: Unique opens, counted by distinct recipient.

count_clicks.description: Unique clicks, counted by distinct recipient.

revenue_generated.description: Revenue attributed via referral tracking, minor units (cents)

fetched_at.description: Epoch ms when these metrics were last fetched from Sparkpost

activity_synced_at.description: Epoch ms when the activity feed was last synced from Sparkpost + orders.

get.description:
Lists Sparkpost bounce or open events for a sent email. Returns one
cursor-paginated page. Events outside the (date_sent - 1 day, now + 1 day)
window aren't returned even if they exist.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description:
Sparkpost event class to fetch.
- bounce: hard/soft bounce, with reason + error code
- open: unique open events

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Sparkpost cursor token; omit for the first page

get.description:
Lists a sent campaign's activity feed (delivered / open / click / bounce /
unsubscribe events plus attributed orders) from the stored feed. Paginated;
filter to one kind with 'view', search recipients with 'search'. Call
sync_email_activity first if the feed looks stale.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded FilterGroup[] for view / custom filtering.

parameters.name: sortField
parameters.description: Whitelist of fields which can be sorted by when listing activity.

eventType.description:
Kind of activity row in the campaign report feed. All but 'order' map to
Sparkpost message-events; 'order' is a conversion row attributed via the
Referral + View join. 'initial_open' (first open) is tracked separately from
'open' (any open, incl. mail-client prefetch).

get.description: Daily counts per event kind for a sent campaign, for charting.

eventType.description:
Kind of activity row in the campaign report feed. All but 'order' map to
Sparkpost message-events; 'order' is a conversion row attributed via the
Referral + View join. 'initial_open' (first open) is tracked separately from
'open' (any open, incl. mail-client prefetch).

get.description: Unique-recipient engagement totals (delivered / opened / clicked / unsubscribed) for a sent campaign.

delivered.description: Distinct recipients with a delivery event.

opened.description: Distinct recipients who opened (open or initial_open).

post.description:
Refreshes a sent campaign's activity feed by pulling the latest Sparkpost
engagement events and attributed orders into storage. Idempotent: re-running
only adds events seen since the last sync. Returns how many rows were added.
